description: This file defines a React component 'MakeModelPublicForm' that provides a user interface for selecting models from a list, filtering, confirming, and making them public within a project. It includes state management, user interactions, API calls, and UI rendering logic.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets component state and calls onClose callback to close the modal.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances the form to the next step after validating model selection.

methods.name: handlePrevious
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step in the form.

methods.name: handleModelSelection
methods.description: Adds or removes a model from the selectedModels set based on user checkbox interactions.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all filtered models.

methods.name: handleFilteredDataChange
methods.description: Updates filtered data while preserving current selections.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Makes an API call to make selected models public, shows notifications, and handles UI updates.

methods.name: renderStep1Content
methods.description: Renders the UI for selecting models, including filter controls and the list of models.

methods.name: renderStep2Content
methods.description: Renders the confirmation UI showing models to be made public and warnings.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Chooses which step's content to render based on currentStep.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons (Cancel/Previous/Next/Make Public) for the form.
